facts.summary: Technical problems with a PDS portal should be handled through the troubleshooting options or official support mechanism provided by the concerned State or Union Territory PDS authority.
common_issues: Login or authentication is not working.
A page or service is not responding.
An application or form cannot be submitted.
The portal displays an error message.
A document upload or download is not working.
basic_troubleshooting: Refresh the portal page and try again.
Verify that the entered information is correct.
Try the service again after a short interval if the portal is temporarily unavailable.
Use the latest version of a supported web browser when applicable.
facts.login_issue: For login-related problems, verify the entered credentials or identification information and follow the authentication or account-recovery options provided by the portal.
facts.otp_issue: For OTP problems, verify the registered contact information and use the resend option if the portal provides one. Do not share the OTP with anyone.
facts.application_issue: If an application cannot be submitted, check the required fields, document requirements and error messages shown by the portal.
facts.document_issue: If document upload fails, verify that the document meets the format and size requirements displayed by the applicable portal.
facts.support: If basic troubleshooting does not resolve the issue, use the official technical-support, helpdesk or grievance mechanism provided by the concerned State/UT PDS authority.
facts.state_specific: Portal features, error messages, browser requirements, support channels and troubleshooting procedures can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Do not assume that the same technical solution works for every State/UT PDS portal.
Do not provide an unofficial support number or website.
Do not ask users to share passwords, OTPs or other authentication credentials.
For persistent technical problems, use the official support mechanism of the applicable PDS portal.

faqs.question: The PDS portal is not opening. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check your internet connection, refresh the page and try again after a short interval. If the problem continues, use the official support mechanism of the concerned State/UT PDS portal.

faqs.question: Why is the PDS website showing an error?
faqs.answer: The error may be caused by a temporary portal problem, incorrect information or another system issue. Check the information entered and follow any troubleshooting instructions displayed by the portal.

faqs.question: I cannot submit my ration-card application online. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check that all required fields and documents have been provided and review any error message shown by the portal. If the issue continues, contact the official support mechanism.

faqs.question: My document is not uploading on the PDS portal. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check the document format and size requirements displayed by the applicable portal and try uploading it again.

faqs.question: The PDS portal OTP is not coming. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Verify the registered contact information and use the resend option if available. If the problem continues, use the official support mechanism.

faqs.question: Who should I contact for a PDS portal technical problem?
faqs.answer: Use the official technical-support, helpdesk or grievance mechanism provided by the concerned State or Union Territory PDS authority.
